'''Creysis's scout squadron''' was an [[Ebruchi]] scout [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] led by [[Ebruchi]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Creysis]]. The scout group was headquartered on an unidentified moon located near the borders between [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The scout squadron patrolled the systems near the base ship of Creysis's [[clan]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Creysis's fleet encountered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Eventually, the scout squadron attacked the ''Admonitor'' and was destroyed in the ensuing battle.

==Composition==
Creysis's scout squadron consisted of a single Ebruchi command ship and thirty-eight Ebruchi fighters.
